more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; processed eggs and egg products.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for the assessed limited food uses.
Higher-dose animal studies identified nervous-system effects of aluminium.
more_info.overview: Aluminium sulphate is an inorganic aluminium salt supplied as a hydrated solid. Its firming role is to help fruit or vegetable tissues remain firm, or support the formation of a gel. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. The specification identifies water solubility as one of its properties.
